name: no-regression-runner-day
about: A day with no regression runner schedules no overnight run and posts no missed-night note (#505: the overnight run was dropped 2026-10-22, #416, since per-PR verify runs the pipeline scenarios). The runner takes items only. With the control as it comes (regression_nightly off) two days pass with no regression_scheduled; with regression_nightly turned on, the nightly scheduler still schedules nothing, since no runner seen can take the run, and #loop never hears of one.
